component_percentiles.2024: Rank each 2024 prediction against the same sleeve and component's concatenated purged 2023 OOF prediction distribution.
component_percentiles.2025: Refit the unchanged selected model through resolved 2024 rows. Rank each 2025 prediction against the complete 2024 out-of-sample raw prediction distribution generated by the frozen 2023 model.
component_percentiles.2026: Refit the unchanged selected model through resolved 2025 rows. Rank each 2026 prediction against the complete 2025 out-of-sample raw prediction distribution generated by the frozen through-2024 model.

score_threshold: For each sleeve and annual model version, calculate the numeric threshold as the selected retention-fraction quantile of the prior causal reference score distribution. The retention fraction, model family and score formula are unchanged after 2024 selection.
